summary: Chilko and Futaleufu now remap the normalized solver depth before shallow/deep optical blending, narrow the former high-roughness matte sun response, strengthen flow-normal breakup, and enforce river-local tagged directional-light intensity and rotation in runtime worlds. The fixed Chilko frame retains a darker blue-green water body. The fixed Futaleufu frame removes the large clipped central sun patch and resolves the standing-wave face into directional glints over visible blue surface texture. This is a renderer-visible improvement, not photoreal acceptance: foam, banks, terrain, vegetation, atmosphere, spray, mist, and characters remain visibly procedural.

root_cause.depth_response: Solver depth is packed as depth divided by four metres. A direct linear material blend kept one-metre shelves only 25 percent attenuated and widened the pale shallow-water transition.
root_cause.highlight_response: The retained 0.68 roughness spread the cold-water directional light into a broad matte lobe. Futaleufu's fixed rapid-side camera was also closely aligned with the shared 55-degree sun azimuth.
root_cause.retained_solution: A parameterized power curve defaults to identity for every river and uses exponent 0.25 for the two cold-water maps. Their migrated live-water response uses 0.42 roughness and 0.72 ripple strength. Tagged runtime light enforcement uses intensity 2.90 at yaw 55 for Chilko and intensity 2.40 at yaw 30 for Futaleufu; regenerated maps serialize the same values.
root_cause.authority_boundary: The change consumes the existing vertex-green depth channel and adjusts material and lighting presentation only. It changes no depth sample, wet/dry mask, water topology, terrain, bathymetry, collision, navigation, buoyancy, raft force, breaking-site ownership, D3, D4, score, or progression state.

chilko_bank_closeup.visual_verdict: Retain. The solver-wet body is materially darker and reads blue-green rather than pale gray. A bright shallow bank region and graphic white streaks remain, so final shoreline and water-art acceptance stay open.

futaleufu_breaking_water_side.visual_verdict: Retain. The broad clipped central hotspot is removed and the right-hand water body exposes blue directional texture. Whitewater remains too linear and graphic, and the synthetic terrain and canopy prevent photoreal acceptance.
